datasets.description: Lesotho Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2021 across Lesotho administrative units. The data represents spatial projections of acute food insecurity phases under different scenarios, with classifications reflecting population vulnerability to food insecurity driven primarily by drought conditions.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity phases driven by underlying hazards including drought.
